name: Urinary antibacterials
summary: Antibiotics used for urinary tract infections; nitrofurantoin is described by the NHS as a medicine for lower urinary tract infections such as cystitis.
mechanism: Antibiotics in this group work by killing the bacteria that cause infection, and they have no effect on infections caused by viruses.
cautions: Kidney function is checked before nitrofurantoin is prescribed, particularly in older people.
Stopping early or skipping doses can make an infection harder to treat and may promote resistance.
classEffects: Nausea, diarrhoea, loss of appetite and headaches are the usual side effects of nitrofurantoin.

references.title: NICE NG109: Urinary tract infection (lower): antimicrobial prescribing
